questions.prompt: In 2023, out of every 1,000 children born worldwide, how many died before reaching their 5th birthday?
questions.insight: Down from roughly 216 per 1,000 in 1950, global child mortality has fallen far faster than most people assume.

questions.prompt: What percentage of the world's electricity was generated from low-carbon sources (renewables plus nuclear combined) in 2024?
questions.insight: Low-carbon power passed 40% of global electricity in 2024, the first time since the 1940s — many assume fossil fuels still dominate.

questions.prompt: What share of global pre-tax income was earned by the world's richest 1% of individuals in 2024?

source.name: World Inequality Database (via Our World in Data)

questions.insight: The top 1% income share has climbed since 1980 but is still well below the roughly 25-30% levels seen in the early 20th century.

questions.prompt: As of 2025, how many billion people are alive on Earth?
questions.insight: World population passed 8 billion in 2022 and is projected to peak around 10.3 billion in the 2080s before gradually declining.

questions.prompt: What percentage of the world's plastic waste was actually recycled in 2019, after accounting for losses in the recycling process?
questions.insight: Only about 9% of plastic waste worldwide is actually recycled; roughly half ends up landfilled and 22% is mismanaged or leaked into nature.
